title: Clandestine Hub
features:
Make a ticket to buy!

* Hitbox Expander (It basically expands your hitbox for everything so you can hit anyone from any distance, but it's detectable by anti cheat so don't abuse it. Disclaimer if it doesn't work, try enabling then going close to the player and then you can move away and it'll work again)
* Hitbox Size (Basically how big it expands your hitbox to, only 200 max because you'll get kicked if u do more 😭)
* Hitbox Method (Change it when the hitbox expander isn't working)
* Lock On (Just the normal console lock on, the keybind is Left Control by default but it's changable)
* Glitched Ping (Makes your ping on the player list glitch)
* Mob Wall Material (This is random but when you do mob's second move, you can change the material of the wall that appears to any material)
* Mob Wall Color (Same thing with material but with any color)
* Play Kill Emote (Basically plays any kill emote you choose in the Kill Emote dropdown, theres every single kill emote in the game and it doesn't work with hitbox expander)
* Force Respawn (respawns you, even if ur stunned or in combat)
* Force Reset (resets you, even if ur stunned or in combat)
* Teleport To Target (teleports you to anyone, since if you tried teleporting normally using like infinite yield or something like that, it wont work)
* Invisible (Makes you invisible and invincible, you cant hit anyone without hitbox expander)
* Walk Speed (sets your walkspeed to whatever)
* Run Speed (sets your runspeed to whatever, its different than walking)
* Jump Height (sets your jump power to whatever)
* Melee Speed (sets your melee speed to whatever, only m1s btw its buggy)
* Melee Cooldown (sets your melee cooldown to whatever, only m1s btw its buggy)
* Dash Cooldown (sets your dash cooldown to whatever, only dashes and if u do frontdash it wont do damage to people)
* Infinite Awakening (you don't really get infinite awakening, you actually just get like +2 minutes to ur ult and mob's  ult moves dont remove ur ult)
* Instant Awakening (this one is actually instant awakening)
* No Stun (really buggy, but just gives u no stun on the client side)
* No Jump Cooldown (removes jump fatigue)

might add more features soon, stay tuned 😄
